verdict.rationale: Supabase docs describe CLI-based migrations captured in version control and branching environments meant to let you test schema changes without affecting production (supabase-docs-25, supabase-docs-26, supabase-docs-36), backed by RLS and database advisors for safety (supabase-docs-7, supabase-docs-16). However, independent community evidence directly contradicts the 'without breaking production' claim: users report 'the local development & database migration story is Supabase's biggest weakness... I hate having to do migrations live in prod' and criticize the dashboard for encouraging direct prod edits rather than CI-driven migrations (supabase-comm-5, supabase-comm-6), and Supabase's own CEO publicly acknowledges the problem, saying 'Please don't use the Dashboard to edit your database in production... we're working on Preview Databases' (supabase-comm-7) — confirming this was an unresolved gap, not just user skepticism. missing for 10: evidence that Preview Databases/branch-merge safety fixes are now fully shipped and resolve the CEO-acknowledged prod-editing problem, and any concrete online-DDL/zero-lock migration tooling beyond basic CLI migrations.
